# provtest

```go
import "github.com/effective-security/xpki/v2/internal/provtest"
```

Package provtest is the conformance suite of the cryptoprov key management contract: every provider of this module runs it against its own backend or fake, so that the rules of a listing mean the same thing on a PKCS\#11 token, on AWS KMS, on Google Cloud KMS and in memory.

The suite generates a small set of keys with a random label prefix, lists and describes them, and destroys them when it ends. It asserts that a full listing at several page sizes returns every key once, that every filter selects the expected keys, that a page token is rejected with another filter or field mask, that no listing returns a public key, that the requested field groups are filled, that a missing key and an unsupported request are reported with cryptoprov.ErrKeyNotFound and cryptoprov.ErrNotSupported, and that a cancelled context fails the call. What a backend cannot do is declared in Config, not skipped silently.

```
func TestConformance(t *testing.T) {
	provtest.Run(t, provtest.Config{
		New: func(t *testing.T) cryptoprov.Provider {
			return inmemcrypto.NewProvider()
		},
		Tags:           true,
		Encrypt:        true,
		MLDSA:          true,
		DestroyRemoves: true,
	})
}
```

<a name="Config"></a>
## type [Config](<https://github.com/effective-security/xpki/blob/main/internal/provtest/testsuite.go#L48-L76>)

Config describes the provider under test and what its backend can do.

```go
type Config struct {
    // New returns the provider, which must implement cryptoprov.KeyManager.
    // The suite calls it once. The store may hold other keys and may be
    // changed by other tests while the suite runs.
    New func(t *testing.T) cryptoprov.Provider

    // Tags reports that keys can be tagged and filtered by tag. Without it
    // the suite asserts cryptoprov.ErrNotSupported for both.
    Tags bool
    // Encrypt reports that RSA encryption keys can be generated. Without it
    // the suite asserts cryptoprov.ErrNotSupported.
    Encrypt bool
    // MLDSA reports that ML-DSA keys can be generated.
    MLDSA bool
    // DestroyRemoves reports that DestroyKey removes a key at once, so that
    // it is not found afterwards. Otherwise the key stays, in a state other
    // than enabled.
    DestroyRemoves bool
    // PagingByLabel makes the paging test give its keys one label and list
    // them by that exact label instead of by a label prefix. It is for a
    // provider whose page token is an offset in the order of the keys that
    // pass the backend's own filter, in a store other tests change: only
    // the exact label keeps that order to the suite's keys.
    PagingByLabel bool
    // ListedID returns the KeyInfo.ID a listing has for the key that
    // IdentifyKey names keyID; nil when they are the same. Google Cloud KMS
    // lists the key and identifies a signer by its version.
    ListedID func(keyID string) string
}
```
